name: Meta Imperium
purpose: Watches public camera feeds and flags scenes for human review across police, fire, and EMS divisions.
proof: server/queue/livecam_records/ (live NYC DOT reading) and os-build/demo/EVAL4.md
limits: Flags only, never confirms. Dispatch goes to a labelled simulated loopback endpoint only; the code refuses every non-loopback URL. Frames are sampled, so events between samples are not seen.
notes: The flagship system and the hackathon submission core.
